chapter_summary: The completed wall receives attention while the maker's name is absent. Debolina sees that silence can be imposed as well as chosen.

spatality.place: a finished wall with morning visitors in front of it
spatality.route: the visitors arrive; the maker stays at the courtyard's edge
spatality.texture: sun on fresh lime, a hand raised to the paint, sandals on stone

poetic_parameters.movement: Confessionalism — the wound exposed, here the wound of being unnamed.
writing_skills: duende — the dark root under a bright surface
a close that turns the omission into an indictment without a target
poetic_parameters.image_seed: a fingertip touching the blue panel where a signature would have gone
poetic_parameters.volta: from pride in the completed wall to the discovery that completion is what erases her
poetic_parameters.sonic_texture: the dark open o of wall, all, who, and a hard coda on the word name
poetic_parameters.line_gesture: refrain-based lines with a repeated half-line, then one line with the refrain cut short
poetic_parameters.variety_note: Chapter fourteen was interrupted before it could be seen; this poem is seen only after the maker has been subtracted from the sentence.
poetic_parameters.metaphor_family: signature, margin, and the unlit space where a hand should be
poetic_parameters.address: the wall, then the visitors, then the wall again
poetic_parameters.closing_move: the name withheld in the poem's own last syllable
